title: Playing around the keys: sitting in with a band
summary: Players would jump through every position and key and test newcomers sitting in.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young

blocks.x: We used to have a habit of playing, going around the bell.
I have it from the first position to the seventh position.
